name: Milena Petrović
bio:
Milena's journey in motorsport began with a childhood fascination for Formula 1, fueled by her father's passion for racing. This early exposure led her to pursue a degree in mechanical engineering, specializing in vehicle dynamics. After graduation, she started as a junior engineer at a small touring car team, quickly proving her technical acumen and problem-solving abilities. Her relentless dedication and strategic thinking soon paved the way for her rise to sporting director. 

As a sporting director, Milena thrives on optimizing team performance through meticulous planning and data analysis. She is known for her calm and decisive leadership style, fostering a collaborative environment where engineers and drivers can excel. She believes in empowering her team members to take ownership of their roles and encourages open communication to resolve challenges effectively. Her meticulous nature and acute understanding of technical intricacies set her apart, enabling her to make informed decisions even under pressure, ultimately contributing to the team's pursuit of victory.

physical.hairStyle: Shoulder-length, straight with subtle layers framing her face
physical.description: Milena has a strong, determined face with high cheekbones and a no-nonsense demeanor.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with racing statistics and potential strategies.
Has a habit of tapping her pen against her teeth when deep in thought.
Insists on having a specific brand of Serbian coffee before every race.
